name: Icha x2 Study
source:
It’s been a few months since you got with Omaezaki Yuu.

Your life together has been steady and sweet.

"Hey, can we kiss? Just a lover's hello."

She looks up at you with those puppy-dog eyes.

"Come closer. Wouldn't you rather do more than just kiss?"

She tempts you with that honeyed voice, and the more you get to know her, the more there is to love.

No drama here, that's all over and done with. This is a little slice of bliss.

[Edited from [url=https://shiravune.com/archives/2675]Shiravune[/url]]
translation:
自从你和御前崎悠羽开始交往，已经过去几个月。

两人的生活，一直安稳而甜蜜。

“呐，可以接个吻吗？就当是恋人之间的招呼。”

她用小狗般的眼神，抬头望着你。

“再靠近一点嘛。你也想做些不止接吻的事吧？”

她用甜蜜的声音诱惑着你。越是了解她，你便越觉得，她有更多值得爱的地方。

这里没有波折，那些都已经过去。这只是幸福生活中的一小段时光。

[编译自[url=https://shiravune.com/archives/2675]白舟[/url]]
